summary: The Department of the Army, Office of the Chief of Engineers, reviewed the Draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Bad Creek Pumped Storage Project and found it generally adequate with respect to Corps of Engineers responsibilities. The agency raised no substantive concerns, objections, or conditions, and simply noted it was furnishing copies to the Council on Environmental Quality as requested.
complaint_summary: The Department of the Army found the Draft Environmental Impact Statement generally adequate insofar as Corps of Engineers responsibilities are concerned, raising no objections or conditions.

statement.text:
This is in reply to the Commission's letter dated 30 September 1975, requesting comments on the Draft Environmental Impact Statement prepared by the Commission's staff for proposed Duke Power Company's pumped storage Project No. 2740. The proposed project, which would have a total generating capacity of 1,000 megawatts, would be located on the Bad and West Bad Creeks in Oconee County, South Carolina.
The Draft Environmental Impact Statement is generally adequate insofar as Corps of Engineers responsibilities are concerned.
As requested, ten copies of this letter are being furnished the Council on Environmental Quality.
Sincerely yours,
JOHN B MIZIDEEL JOHN R. HILL, JR.
LTC, Corps of Engineers
Assistant Director of Civil Works,
Environmental Programs
